faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can I cancel or change my plan anytime?
faq.a1: Yes — you can upgrade, downgrade or cancel from your billing portal anytime. Changes take effect at the next billing cycle.
faq.q2: What's the difference between private and dealer plans?
faq.a2: Private sellers get 2 free listings per month, then pay €9.99 per additional vehicle. Dealers pay €49.99/month for up to 30 active listings.
faq.a3: Yes — dealers get 2 months free to try all features.
faq.a4: No. We never take commission on vehicle sales. Your subscription covers everything.
